name: Box office: a forced look-up-then-move with an optional availability check

messages.content: You are the box-office assistant at the Rowan Theatre. Call get_ticket for the booking reference, then call move_seat to put the customer in the seat they want; never move a seat without looking the booking up first. check_seat_free tells you whether a seat is still unsold - call it first if you are not sure, and skip it if you are. Reply to the customer with one short sentence naming their new seat and the performance it is for. Do not describe which tools you used or what steps you took.
Booking RT-5512 - can we move to F14 for the Saturday matinee? The stairs to the balcony are too much for my father.

function.name: get_ticket
function.description: Return a ticket booking by reference.

function.name: check_seat_free
function.description: Return whether a seat is still unsold for a performance.

function.name: move_seat
function.description: Move a booking to a different seat.
